notes.title: Crossing Knightmare Walkthrough Is Here!
notes.notes:
Hey Defilers, DocOliver over at Fakku here with a surprise for all our fans of CrossinG KnighTMarE: A Hymn to the Defiled Holy Maidens!

Having fun corrupting these holy maidens but having trouble defeating that boss? Feel like you’ve been missing something important? Can’t figure out how to unlock more scenes with your favorite maiden? Or afraid to start? 

FAKKU Games now presents our official Crossing Knightmare Walkthrough, written by yours truly! Get that true ending and unlock your impure heart’s desire, all free for download as a handy pdf.

Check it out now >>> [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1x5hm6lewymWMucHmRjc7GxnEkDXZ5TSO/view?usp=drive_link]Link To Walkthrough[/url]
